schedule._comment: Cron runs at 13:00 and 14:00 UTC. The function checks the Central hour and exits unless it is readoutHourCentral on a working weekday. DST is not chased in the cron string.

dashboard._comment_testReadout: The test readout posts a real message to a channel other people read, and a post cannot be unposted. Five minutes, against the refresh button's one: the throttle here is about the channel, not the API.
dashboard._comment_session: A sign-in lasts 30 days (Alex, 2026-10-22), so the dashboard is not a daily login. Signing in again is one password on the screen the page returns to.

standup._comment: #ecomm-team, where the team posts Yesterday / Today / Blockers each morning. Read only, live when the Stand-up tab opens and when Ideation runs. The bot must be a member: it is a private channel. Who is expected to post is everyone on the roster who posted at least once in the lookback.

anthropic._comment: Only the Strategic Advisor, the Learning Skill and Ideation spend tokens, each on Alex's click or reply. The daily pipeline spends none.

github._comment: Where the learning skill opens its proposal pull requests. NOT secrets: a repo name and a branch name are public, and putting them in the environment was a mistake. Netlify's secrets scanner treats every environment value as something to hunt for in the build output, so GITHUB_DEFAULT_BRANCH=main failed the build on every occurrence of the word 'main' in an HTML tag or a CSS selector. Only GITHUB_TOKEN belongs in the environment.

flags._comment: How long a flag can sit before it is treated as more urgent, and how long a wait lasts by default. Working days, so a weekend does not age a flag.

supabase._comment: Layer 1's rocks and tactics are read from the marketing standup's Supabase project, for this team, this quarter. READ ONLY: the app only ever sends GET requests there (src/collectors/supabase-rocks.js, enforced by test/supabase-rocks.test.js). The key is SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY, a Netlify secret. What only this app knows (ClickUp owner, Big Swing link, experiment and report links) is kept in its own storage, keyed by the Supabase id. Remove this block to go back to the dashboard's own rocks store.
